border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Correct	Male &num;3	Incorrect

It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Correct	Male &num;3	Incorrect

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Correct	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Incorrect

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Correct	Male &num;3	Incorrect

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Correct

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Correct	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Incorrect

It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Correct

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Correct	Male &num;3	Incorrect

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Correct	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Incorrect

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Correct	Male &num;3	Incorrect

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Correct

It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Correct	Male &num;3	Incorrect

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Correct	Male &num;3	Incorrect

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Correct

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Correct

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Correct

It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Correct	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Incorrect

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Correct	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Incorrect

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Correct	Male &num;3	Incorrect

border-right: 1px solid #E0E0E0" colspan="31" bgcolor="#E0E0E0" height="10"></td> </tr> </table> <h6>Background</h6><p>Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) is a molecular biology technique used to distinguish between closely related DNA samples. It's commonly employed in paternity tests, among other applications.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In actual diagnostic processes, the results of RFLP for confirming paternity are often cited to provide a 99.9% accuracy level or higher. However, no test is foolproof. Legal confirmation may involve additional procedures and evaluations to ensure the integrity and admissibility of the test.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Use the provided DNA gel profile to determine paternity. Each band in the gel corresponds to a DNA fragment. Fragments are inherited; thus, the child's DNA will have overlapping fragments with the true father.</p>	Male &num;1	Incorrect	Male &num;2	Incorrect	Male &num;3	Correct
